annotations.title: EVM token contract risk scan with AI verdict

description: [$0.01] On-chain EVM token contract risk scan: proxy upgradeability, owner renouncement, mint/blacklist/fee/trading-toggle functions in bytecode, and DEX liquidity, scored 0-100 with a local qwen3.5:4b verdict and reasons. Do not use for token price/FDV/liquidity (use token_market_snapshot) or pre-tx simulation (use workflow_tx_guardian). `chain` accepts EVM networks (base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism; not Solana), and expiring `timeout_ms` returns `degraded=true` omitting the LLM verdict. Live RPC bytecode + DEX, read-only; requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.

session_token.description: Optional prepaid session token (x402s_...) from https://apix402data.com/pay after the 10-call free preview.

timeout_ms.description: Optional deadline in ms. If the local LLM would exceed it, the response comes back fast with "degraded": true and non-LLM/cached data
